_comment: Copy this to ~/.config/omarchy-switchyard/rules.json and edit. version is the rules-file format; leave it at 1. Each entry in rules is tried in order; the first whose host matches wins. A host ("basecamp.com" or "*.basecamp.com", the same rule either way) matches that domain and all its subdomains; there's no way to match a host and exclude its subdomains. target is the word "webapp", which opens the link as a Chromium web-app window, or a desktop id ("chromium.desktop", "zen.desktop", ...). A link that matches no rule, or any link while this file is missing, goes to the fallback browser in the sibling 'fallback' file, which 'omarchy-switchyard activate' writes and this file never touches.
